limits: Four public Retry transcript conflicts are independently verified protocol violations under RFC9000 section17.2.5.3, not four accepted TLS transcript updates.
Three unmodified aioquic1.7 Retry cases receive application responses despite replacing ClientHello. Receipt is not conformance and is not promoted to a valid native transcript.
The positive control explicitly preserves the first TLS private context/ClientHello on Retry; this is a declared peer adaptation, not an unmodified production implementation.
Public Initial keys and Retry tag verify bytes/context, not peer identity.
The separate cryptographic corruption tests intentionally rebind certificate hashes only to exercise the independent crypto checks; mutated certificates are never physical capture certificates.
Unnumbered version-negotiation absence is unit checked; native VN ingress/compatible VN remains unselected.
Packet rejection cache follows the128-entry PN observation window per direction/space. It does not certify general packet-number reuse, stateless resets, or all QUIC conformance.
Reference HTTP3 field omissions/repeated/unknown frame views are retained; literal peer bytes and STREAM reconstruction independently bind native fields.
Sharon candidate/fuzz/derived carrier views, native v2 and broader protocol completeness remain open.

independent_crypto_negative_controls.scope:
Exercise independent Retry/Initial crypto checks with explicitly rebound inputs.
These mutations bypass only the prior header-certificate hash binding so the
separate crypto/transcript checks are exercised. Rebound certificates are test
inputs, never replacement certificates for the original physical capture.

declared_offline_duplicate_control.scope: Explicit offline excerpt and byte-identical packet duplication control, not an additional real capture.
